tools.name: create_release
tools.description: Saves a company's press release as a draft in the signed-in account and checks it: length, structure, links, image size and content. tools.name: update_release
tools.description: Changes fields of a draft press release (only the fields you send) and checks the whole release again. Returns the problems to fix, or the updated preview link. Uses no credit.

tools.name: add_image
tools.description: Adds a cover image to a draft press release. Send an image URL, or a file the user attached in the chat. tools.name: publish_release
tools.description: Publishes the latest saved version of a draft press release on LivePublicator, including changes the user made on the draft page, and tells search engines about it. Only call this after the user has seen the preview and clearly said to publish, and set confirm to true. Uses 1 credit. Returns the liv

tools.description: Shows where a press release is: draft, waiting for a person to check it, scheduled or live, with the live link once it is published. Only when the user asks about a release later. tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: Lists the account's earlier press releases with their status and links. Only when the user asks about their earlier releases. Not needed to draft or publish a new one. Returns up to 50 releases, newest first, each with its id, headline, status and links.

tools.name: fix_live_release
tools.description: Fixes the text of a published press release within 24 hours of it going live: a typo, a wrong date, a link, the quote. Send only the fields to change. The release keeps the same link and the earlier version is kept. The change is checked again before it shows. After 24 hours the text can't be change

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_release_status · Private data: preview_press_release, get_account, create_release, add_image · Public sink: preview_press_release, create_release, update_release, add_image, publish_release, list_releases, fix_live_release · Destructive: add_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_release_status · Private data: preview_press_release, get_account, create_release, add_image · Public sink: preview_press_release, create_release, update_release, add_image, publish_release, list_releases, fix_live_release · Destructive: add_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_account" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
